cohort: The study included 74 pregnant women at 35 or more gestational weeks with complaints of reduced fetal movement, compared with 74 healthy pregnant women as controls.
finding: Reduced fetal movement was associated with a lower biophysical profile, and in such cases, placental chorangiosis and hypercoiled cord were significantly higher, especially in relation to fetal growth restriction.
cross-section timing: Data collected prospectively between December 26, 2017 and January 30, 2019.
gest_age: 35 or more gestational weeks; term pregnancies between 37 0/7 and 40 6/7 weeks were evaluated separately.
